name: haile-monorepo
description: Haile — monorepo. /web = DUO (React/Vite). /packages/shared = lógica compartilhada. /supabase = backend único. (Dino vanilla segue em app/ e *.html na raiz.)

scripts.deploy:app: npm run build -w web && rm -rf app && mkdir -p app && cp -R web/dist/. app/ && echo '[deploy:app] built and copied to /app/'
